    // The colour of the gradient at the given parameter; transparent black when
    // the gradient carries no stops at all.
    ColorAtParameter(self: ColorGradient, t: Number): Color
        => self.Stops.Count == 0 ? Color(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0) : self.GradientSample(t);
